content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text decides a link by comparing the challenger's and defender's chains and assigning underdetermination based on their footing and whether they expressly name or infer the point.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse","room":"by footing, never verse by verse — I weighed (1) footing/support alone governs, so a footed chain cannot be rejected merely for not naming Joseph, versus (2) a footed chain still fails if its verses do not expressly name the required begetter.","why":"The judge finds the challenger's chain footed yet rejects it because it does not name Joseph, which is an express-statement test rather than deciding the chain-vs-chain collision solely by footing."}
